skills.name: Superposition
skills.description: Natan shoots a dense mass of energy in the target direction, dealing 225<font color='#D58E1F'>( +100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#27C0C7'>(+140% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies in its path.

skills.name: Interference!
skills.description:
Natan launches a Gravitational Attractor in the target direction, dealing 150<font color='#D58E1F'>( +50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#27C0C7'>(+70% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies in its path and knocking them back.
The Attractor detonates upon reaching the maximum range, dealing 30<font color='#D58E1F'>( +10% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#27C0C7'>(+14% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to nearby enemies and knocking them back.

skills.name: Entropy?
skills.description:
Natan summons a <font color='#404495'>(Reverse-Clone)</font> at a target location 6 units away that lasts 10s, inherits 35% of his attack attributes (and a portion of Attack Effects), and will copy his moves and attacks in reverse.
<font color='#404495'>(Use Again)</font>: Natan switches places with the <font color='#404495'>(Reverse-Clone)</font>.
Each cast reduces other skills' remaining cooldowns by 50%. The <font color='#404495'>(Reverse-Clone)</font> will disappear if Natan is too far away, while the cooldown of this skill will be reduced by the remaining duration.

skills.name: Theory of Everything
skills.description:
Natan gains a stack of <font color='#404495'>(Entanglement)</font> each time he or his <font color='#404495'>(Reverse-Clone)</font> hits an enemy with a skill (up to 6 stacks). Each stack lasts 5s and grants 7.5% Attack Speed and 7.5% Movement Speed.
Natan's Basic Attack projectiles will return to Natan after reaching the maximum range, dealing an extra 30<font color='#D58E1F'>( +50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#27C0C7'>(+70% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies along the way (inherits a portion of Attack Effects).

items.name: Feather of Heaven
items.des: Unique Passive - Affliction: Basic Attacks deal extra Magic Damage equal to 50 plus 30% of the hero's Magic Power.

items.name: Golden Staff
items.des: Unique Passive - Swift: Every 1% extra Crit Chance gained is converted into 1% extra Attack Speed.

items.name: Holy Crystal
items.des: Unique Passive - Mystery: Gains 21%-35% extra Magic Power (scales with level).

items.name: Concentrated Energy
items.des: Unique Passive - Recharge: Increases Magic Power by 5 after dealing Magic Damage (this effect stacks up to 6 times and can only gain 1 stack every 0.4s). When reaching full stacks, increases Magic Damage by 12% for 3s.

items.name: Divine Glaive
items.des: Unique Passive - Spellbreaker: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.1% extra Magic Penetration for each point of the enemy's Magic Defense, capped at 20%.
